user.title: HRI Probe
user.description: A test integration: it creates one entity on every platform Home Assistant has.

tick.name: Tick
tick.description: Change the entities that have no service of their own (sensors, binary sensor, event, device tracker).

flap.name: Flap availability
flap.description: Make every hri_probe entity unavailable, then available again.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the entities stay unavailable.

notify.name: Persistent notification
notify.description: Create or dismiss a persistent notification.

notification_id.name: Notification id
notification_id.description: Same id replaces the previous notification.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Dismiss the notification with that id instead of creating it.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Answer with the payload it was called with (a service that returns a response).

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Any JSON object; it comes back in the response.

fail.name: Fail
fail.description: Raise an error, to check how a failed call is reported.

slow.name: Slow call
slow.description: Take longer than the caller's timeout.

stuck.name: Block an executor thread
stuck.description: Test case - one executor thread waits forever.
